findings.title: LegionellaGuard.hours_since() negative-elapsed clamp is untested
findings.claim: hours_since() clamps a negative elapsed time to 0.0, but no test in the tree ever sets last_cycle/attempt to a future timestamp, so removing the clamp is undetected by the committed suite and would silently push the anti-legionella due time later after a backward clock step.
findings.mechanism: due_in_hours() = interval_days*24 - hours_since(); an unclamped negative hours_since() (last_cycle in the future) increases due_in_hours(), delaying the disinfection cycle beyond the configured interval.

findings.title: dhw-min/setpoint deadband boundary untested at both service call sites
findings.claim: handle_set_thermal_params and handle_apply_schedule each independently enforce "minimum must leave a deadband below setpoint" with a strict > comparison, and minimum == ceiling (exact zero deadband) is accepted by both at baseline; no test in the tree calls either service at that exact boundary, so a boundary-off mutation (> to >=) in either survives.
findings.mechanism: two independently-written copies of one invariant (ceiling = setpoint - DHW_MIN_TEMP_SETPOINT_MARGIN; if value > ceiling: raise) in services.py, each covered by its own tests/features.py assertion, neither reaching minimum == ceiling exactly.
